Initial release — generates a finance section for board decks directly from P&L exports.

- Converts period financials into structured board-ready text: headline metrics, movement, narrative, and unknowns.
- Matches prior board deck formats if supplied, always with an explicit "couldn't figure out" section.
- Requires current-period P&L export; refuses to proceed on missing or invalid data.
- Never invents numbers or causes; all figures/narrative are strictly traceable to input or explicitly marked as assumptions.
- Always lists any metric or explanation it could not determine from input.
